submission.justification: Algorithm-L3 at 33 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency (93.64%) among all tested configurations while meeting all constraints. This represents the peak performance identified through systematic scanning and fine-tuning. L3 consistently outperforms L2 and L1 by approximately 7-18% across the threshold range, making it the clear choice for maximizing signal efficiency at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate.

requirements.requirement: Algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L3 is one of the three candidate algorithms (L1, L2, L3) evaluated in the simulation.

requirements.requirement: Algorithm must be deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L3 is listed as a candidate option, indicating it has been pre-validated for Level-1 trigger hardware deployment.
The recommended threshold of 33 GeV falls within the required range of 20-60 GeV.

requirements.requirement: Achieve highest possible signal efficiency at allocated trigger rate
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L3 at 33 GeV achieves 93.64% efficiency, the highest among all tested configurations. The simulation systematically tested thresholds and algorithms at the allocated 8 kHz rate.
